newsitem.title: UK: NatWest shares up on switching from Abbey.
newsitem.headline: NatWest shares up on switching from Abbey.

text.p: Shares in National Westminster Bank Plc rose in a falling market on Thursday as investors switched into the stock from Abbey National Plc after Abbey's bid for Scottish Amicable was topped by one from Prudential Corp, dealers said.
A positive article in the Wall Street Journal Europe, which pointed out that NatWest's share price had lagged other banks, may also have boosted the stock, dealers said.
NatWest shares were up 3-1/2p at 800 by 0927 GMT.
Abbey National shares were 10-1/2p weaker at 771-1/2 after its offer for Scottish Amicable was surpassed by a higher bid from Prudential.
"A lot of people have been moving out of Abbey National and switching into NatWest," one market-maker said.
ScoGen analyst John Tyce said he had been recommending a switch from Barclays Plc into NatWest this week, because of the price differential between the two.
"Barclays is a better bank but not by that much," he said.
